sources.title: Moldova MFA: visa regime for citizens of the Republic of Moldova
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Moldova
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Moldova MFA consular table, updated 20 February 2026, has distinct diplomatic, service and ordinary-passport columns and a visa-obtaining-method column for each destination.

sources.title: Gabon DGDI e-Visa: electronic authorization and arrival sticker
sources.publisher: Direction Générale de la Documentation et de l'Immigration, Gabon
sources.officialityEvidence: The DGDI-branded official immigration portal requires a Travel Authorization Receipt before travel and says payment is made on arrival when the e-visa sticker is delivered.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Applicants should not travel ... without having received the Travel Authorization Receipt. Payments are made on arrival at delivery of the e-visa sticker.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire official SNEDAI: e-visa procedure
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, official Côte d'Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: SNEDAI identifies itself as the only visa-application website approved by Côte d'Ivoire and says that, after approved pre-enrolment, the visa is printed and issued at the airport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le demandeur embarque avec le document « Pré-enrôlement approuvé » ... le visa est imprimé et délivré immédiatement.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: tourism e-Visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Nigeria Immigration Service service-level agreement calls the tourism route an e-Visa, makes citizens of all countries eligible, and says a visa certificate is received by email.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

policies.title: Moldovan ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Moldova MFA's current ordinary-passport table records visa-free short visits for Bosnia and Herzegovina, Panama, Tunisia and Ukraine.
conditions: The MFA table states 90 days for Bosnia and Herzegovina, Tunisia and Ukraine; for Panama it records return tickets and a passport valid for three months.
This does not establish Transnistria routing, border-opening, work, residence, special-document or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: Moldovan ordinary passports: named advance consular visitor visas
policies.summary: Moldova MFA's current ordinary-passport table requires a visa and identifies diplomatic missions as the obtaining method for these destinations.
conditions: Apply through the relevant diplomatic mission and obtain the visitor visa before departure; this is an advance consular route, not an inference from generic visa wording.
Mission operation, invitation requirements, Syrian and Afghan governmental-transition issues, closures, routes through Transnistria, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Moldovan ordinary passports: named electronic visitor visas
policies.summary: Moldova MFA's current ordinary-passport table records eVisa as the obtaining method for these destinations; Nigeria independently confirms its tourism eVisa is open to citizens of all countries and sent by email.
conditions: Obtain the electronic visitor visa before departure using the destination portal linked by Moldova MFA. Nigeria's tourism eVisa is specifically available to citizens of all countries and issues a certificate by email.

Cuba's listed eVisa route excludes maritime travel, for which Moldova MFA says a diplomatic mission is required. Purpose, duration, availability, closure, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Moldovan ordinary passports: named arrival visitor visas
policies.summary: Moldova MFA records visas on arrival for Comoros and Liberia; the Côte d'Ivoire and Gabon destination portals establish that their online preapproval routes end in issuance at the airport.
conditions: For Liberia, Moldova MFA states that the online form and printed confirmation are mandatory before the visa-on-arrival step. For Comoros, it records visa on arrival.

For Côte d'Ivoire, board with approved pre-enrolment and complete biometrics at Abidjan, where the visa is printed and issued. For Gabon, obtain a DGDI Travel Authorization Receipt before travel; the sticker is delivered and paid for on arrival at Libreville airport.
